sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and verification

Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 of this section cites exactly one physical page, within physical pages forty-three to fifty-two, of the private snapshot of the Alabama Driver Manual edition dated on its front cover, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: four-way stop order, speed and clearance figures printed in sign captions, and the bicycle passing clearance are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so no learner line copies the manual.
Accuracy flags: none open; these are picture pages, so only text facts were taken: sign meanings come from the printed captions and from sign words that extracted as text, while sign pictures, individual sign shapes and colors, and the dimension labels on the last page were not read, and no caption was paired with a picture unless the sign's own words appear in the text.
Stability: the manual is one dated edition; any rule a later law or edition changes must be re-read from the current manual before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.

corpus_stability.reason: The Alabama Driver Manual is one dated edition (front cover, physical p1, prints November 2024); nothing on the selected pages indicates more than one rewrite per year.
